name: Chromeless
description: Adds a "chromeless" query parameter which, when present, makes Drupal render only the main content of a page.
project_description: Chromeless lets you render only the main content of a page by adding chromeless=1 to the URL query parameters; all blocks in the block layout (header, footer, sidebars, etc.) are hidden while chromeless mode is active. It provides two query parameters: 'chromeless' (any non-zero integer enables the mode, 0 disables it) and 'title' (controls whether the page title shows while chromeless mode is active). Visiting a URL with either parameter stores that preference in the visitor's private temp store for the current session (retained for one week by default), so it persists across subsequent requests without needing the parameter each time. The module has no mandatory configuration or post-installation steps. The two query-parameter names can be customized by overriding the 'chromeless.query.active' and 'chromeless.query.title' container parameters in a site-wide services.yml. Useful for embedding Drupal pages in iframes, generating print/PDF-friendly views, or kiosk/display contexts.
